note: Stream-json sessions of the pinned binary against a stub /v1/messages. The routed runs launch with ANTHROPIC_MODEL=local/model-a and send set_model local/model-b before the first user message: before_first_turn with the stub answering the one-token check, refused_not_found with the stub answering it 404, unanswered with the stub holding it for 30 s. answered_after_s is the time from the request to Claude Code's answer, probes lists the one-token requests, first_turn_models the models of the first turn's requests. The typed runs use the Anthropic env: one turn, then /model claude-haiku-4-5 as an input with the stub answering its check 429 (typed_model_refused) or 200 (typed_model_confirmed), then one more turn; synthetic_text is the text of the <synthetic> assistant line the command answered with, and turn_models the models of every turn request.
